question.text: Section XIII of the SEBI-prescribed PPM template (Distribution Waterfall) requires illustrative distribution scenarios to be shown for all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Fund at no profit or loss
Fund earning profits below the hurdle rate
Fund's top three portfolio positions by gross exposure

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 Section XIII lists 5 scenarios: (a) fund at loss, (b) no profit/no loss, (c) profits below hurdle, (d) profits at hurdle, (e) profits above hurdle. A 'top three portfolio positions' disclosure is not a Section XIII waterfall illustration; portfolio-position content sits in the investment-strategy disclosure (page 231) rather than Section XIII. The Trap: Distractors A, B, C are verbatim from the template. The trap is mistaking a portfolio-exposure disclosure (a different section) for a waterfall-scenario requirement. Note: Page 235 of the workbook contains the Section XIII five-scenario list; HWM/performance-fee context appears separately on page 114.
